components.name: Primary Contact Button
components.description: The singular action for starting a Telegram conversation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; gap:18px; align-items:center; background:#2D63E5; color:#fff; padding:16px 21px; border-radius:6px; font:650 15px/1 'Golos Text',Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#17141D; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2D63E5; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Proof Link
components.description: Secondary link that leads to cases and their materials.

components.css: .ds-project-row { padding:32px 0; border-top:1px solid #D8D5DE; color:#17141D; font-family:'Golos Text',Arial,sans-serif; transition:background 200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-project-row:hover { background:#E4F1EE; } .ds-project-row h3 { margin:8px 0 12px; font-size:28px; line-height:1.05; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-project-row p { max-width:60ch; color:#625D69; line-height:1.5; } .ds-project-kind { color:#2B6A61 !important; font:600 11px/1.2 'Golos Text',Arial,sans-serif !important; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-project-row a { display:inline-block; margin-top:16px; color:#2D63E5; font-weight:650; text-decoration:none; } .ds-project-row a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2D63E5; outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: A proof-led technical educator portfolio built around a single dark-studio Hero photograph. Blue handles primary action, mineral teal provides limited orientation, and case materials do the persuasive work.
keyCharacteristics: Blue for action, mineral teal for orientation

rules.name: The Single-Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue invites action; mineral teal provides orientation. Never combine them in a gradient, glow, or competing pair of buttons.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: Every headline claim should sit near inspectable proof.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from surface changes and dividers, not decorative shadows.

dos: Use #2D63E5 for the single primary CTA.
Use #2B6A61 for supporting orientation, including icons, metadata, and hover states.
Make project material links easy to inspect.
donts: Don't use competing blue-and-teal decoration, neon glows, or glass surfaces.
Don't use childlike classroom styling or collage layouts.
Don't add a second portrait outside the Hero.
